She also has mental health issues & struggles to get out the house. In her last home visit from the surgery, she was told she had fatty liver disease. She has gained 4 stone in the last year, not lost weight.
She asked the doctor for weight loss jabs as her last hope & resort. The “weight loss team” refused, stating that because she hasn’t had a stroke or developed diabetes yet then they won’t prescribe the weight loss jab.
I am shocked & horrified that they would wait for her to have a stroke first. The stroke could be life-changing, she might need care. Isn’t that going to burden the NHS & care system more in the long-term? The weight loss jab could mitigate a stroke! It beggars belief they won’t help her now & potentially allow her to cost the NHS (taxpayers) more due to needing insulin or stroke care.
The weight loss team? What an abomination! Each case should be dealt with on their own merit, not this tick-box farce.
We see women who weigh less getting the jabs who haven’t got diabetes or had a stroke.
You don’t want people to use online services for jabs but you don’t really give them much option!
Have a stroke or go online & buy it with risk, how helpful of you all……",null,[0,240]]]],[null,1770723060000000,1770723060000000,"a month ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/3959016834535067291/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRLZDJSWFp6Tk5ia1l5V1d4R1JWTXhhRXhXYWtreFRsaHNObVJHUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/3959016834535067291/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRLZDJSWFp6Tk5ia1l5V1d4R1JWTXhhRXhXYWtreFRsaHNObVJHUlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/3959016834535067291/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRLZDJSWFp6Tk5ia1l5V1d4R1JWTXhhRXhXYWtreFRsaHNObVJHUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/3959016834535067291/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRLZDJSWFp6Tk5ia1l5V1d4R1JWTXhhRXhXYWtreFRsaHNObVJHUlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/3959016834535067291/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRLZDJSWFp6Tk5ia1l5V1d4R1JWTXhhRXhXYWtreFRsaHNObVJHUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/3959016834535067291/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRLZDJSWFp6Tk5ia1l5V1d4R1JWTXhhRXhXYWtreFRsaHNObVJHUlJBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Please contact the practice directly so we can discuss this with you.
